scenarios.title: Verify evaluation results loading from updated filename
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the application correctly loads evaluation results from the renamed file evaluation/result.json instead of evaluation/results.json.

scenarios.title: Check fallback behavior when evaluation results file missing
scenarios.purpose: Verify that when the evaluation/result.json file is missing, the UI displays the appropriate message indicating no results yet.

scenarios.title: Validate evaluation summary display after results loading
scenarios.purpose: Confirm the evaluation summary panel correctly shows cohort size, model name, and date after loading results from evaluation/result.json.
